text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(A book report... huh.
I really don't feel like reading stories
about love and romance, but—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: A biography of a great figure... I wonder if this will be alright.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...And he preached,
'All you need is love.
With love, nothing else—'"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
......
Perhaps I should choose a different book...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It ended up meaning we had to start over
from selecting the books once more.
